Each isolated entirely in its own cell. Exact 6 by 6 layout.

cycles:
Production pixel art locomotion sprite atlas. Match Chava in reference 1 exactly, same adult face short black hair, green polo white collar, navy trousers, green-white-black sneakers, black controller. SINGLE image with EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows equally spaced, 16 full body sprites, all facing RIGHT. Plain solid bright magenta #ff00ff background with absolutely no checkerboard, no shadows, no text. Each cell same size. Figures same scale, feet at same baseline, root centered. Pixel art SNK KOF 2002 shading and proportions same as reference. ALL frames must have distinct leg positions. This is a complete walking and running cycle suitable for animation, legs must pass one another.
FIRST TWO ROWS = EIGHT consecutive WALK cycle frames, read left to right:
1 front/near leg forward heel contact, rear/far leg back toe contact.
2 weight transfer downward, near knee slightly bends, far foot lifts behind.
3 PASSING pose: feet nearly together horizontally, planted near leg straight vertical under hips, far knee bent passing forward.
4 HIGH pose: far knee rising in front, near heel lifting behind.
5 opposite CONTACT: far leg forward straight heel contact, near leg behind straight toe contact.
6 weight transfer downward, far knee slightly bends, near foot lifts behind.
7 opposite PASSING: far leg vertical planted under hips, near knee bent passing forward; feet nearly together horizontally.
8 near knee rising forward, far heel lifting behind.
Both hands hold controller at waist throughout walk. Do not repeat the same wide stance eight times.
LAST TWO ROWS = EIGHT consecutive RUN frames, proper cycle with both feet leaving ground during flight, alternating foot contacts, running lean forward, controller in one hand, arm swing. Frame1 near leg forward reach far back, frame2 near contact compressed, frame3 near support far knee passes, frame4 flight far knee forward, frame5 opposite far forward reach near back, frame6 far contact compressed, frame7 far support near knee passes, frame8 flight near knee forward. Anatomically consistent limbs, same size every pose, clean pixel outlines, no motion trails. EXACT 4x4 uniform layout.
